faq.question: How long should I wear Mytipe Alignment Socks each day?
faq.answer: Start with 15–30 minutes per day while resting or sitting. As your toes and foot muscles naturally adjust, gradually increase wear time to 1–2 hours or overnight while sleeping.

faq.question: Can I wear these alignment socks inside regular shoes?
faq.answer: No. These therapeutic toe-separator socks are designed with padded toe dividers to gently stretch and realign your toes. They are intended for barefoot use at home while resting, relaxing on the couch, sleeping, or during yoga.

faq.question: How do these socks help relieve bunions, plantar fasciitis, and foot pain?
faq.answer: The soft cushioned dividers gently separate overlapping toes, decompressing joint stress, stretching tight tendons, and restoring natural arch alignment to relieve heel, arch, and ball-of-foot pressure.

faq.question: Will it feel uncomfortable when I first start wearing them?
faq.answer: It is normal to feel a gentle stretching sensation initially as compressed toes adjust. If it feels too tight, wear them for just 10–15 minutes at first and build up duration gradually.

faq.question: How should I wash and care for my alignment socks?
faq.answer: Hand wash or machine wash in cold water on a delicate cycle using mild detergent. Air dry flat in shade to keep the plush toe separators in optimal shape.

faq.answer: It is normal to feel a gentle stretching sensation initially as compressed toes adjust. If it feels too tight, wear them for just 10–15 minutes at first and build up duration gradually.

faq.question: How should I wash and care for my alignment socks?
faq.answer: Hand wash or machine wash in cold water on a delicate cycle using mild detergent. Air dry flat in shade to keep the plush toe separators in optimal shape.
